svg.title: 4 P i,j⟨Fij, Fij⟩, the tensor trace is 4(w0 + 4w1)Q; hence ρ reads minus that trace in Q-units. It kills E and the traceless conserved tensor w = (1, −1/4, 1). Since (FC10) proves that the raw equation kernel is exactly RE, ρ annihilates that entire kernel. This is the scalar sensor used later, with its sign and normalization fixed. The identification of the free quotient here uses the Maxwell polynomial evaluation and the reflected Gram norm proved in (FM3)–(FM4) and in the detector’s reflected polynomial calculation; it is not an additional assumption of nondegeneracy.
